categories.main_business_segments: Oisix ra daichi Inc. operates five main business segments: BtoC Subscription (direct-to-consumer food and daily goods delivery via brands like Oisix, Daichi wo Mamoru Kai, Radish Boya, and Purple Carrot), BtoB Subscription (food supply and meal services for nurseries, corporate/educational/medical facilities), Social Services (outsourced management of public facilities, school meals, after-school clubs), Vehicle Operation Services (outsourced vehicle management for public and private sectors), and Other (including EC support, mobile supermarkets, and investment businesses).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary cultivation and production standards for environmentally friendly, high-value food products, and advanced logistics systems. It utilizes data-driven algorithms to match consumer preferences with agricultural production, AI-based demand forecasting, and internalized food processing and meal kit manufacturing. Sustainability is emphasized through upcycling, food loss reduction, and the use of eco-friendly packaging.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include individual consumers (especially dual-income families and health-conscious households), nurseries, schools, hospitals, elderly care facilities, corporations, government agencies, and local municipalities. The company also serves the foodservice industry and operates in both B2C and B2B markets, with a growing presence in the U.S. through its plant-based meal kit brand Purple Carrot.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s primary operations are in Japan, with nationwide coverage for its delivery and service networks. It also has an international presence, notably in the United States (via Purple Carrot) and Hong Kong, and operates through subsidiaries and affiliates in various regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Oisix ra daichi operates at the midstream and downstream points of the supply chain, connecting producers directly with end consumers and institutional clients. It manages procurement, processing, logistics, and last-mile delivery, while also engaging in upstream activities through direct relationships with producers and investments in agri-tech.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the BtoC subscription business, expanding BtoB meal services through M&A and innovation, and addressing social and environmental challenges in food. The company focuses on sustainability (food loss, plastic reduction, supply chain resilience), digital transformation, and leveraging data analytics. While there is no traditional R&D department, innovation is driven through business model evolution, product development, and investment in food/agri-tech startups.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales (food, meal kits, daily goods) via subscription and one-off purchases, as well as service fees for BtoB meal provision, facility management, and vehicle operation outsourcing. Additional revenue streams include EC support, mobile supermarkets, and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include domestic food delivery services, co-ops, supermarket chains with online delivery, and other meal kit providers. In BtoB, large-scale food service and catering companies are key rivals. Oisix ra daichi differentiates itself through premium, sustainable offerings and a strong subscription model, holding a small but growing share in the Japanese food delivery market and aiming for a top-tier position in institutional meal services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached 256.0 billion yen (up 72.5% YoY), with operating profit of 6.86 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 3.64 billion yen. The company has over 11,800 employees (including part-timers), and has shown rapid growth, especially after the acquisition of Shidax and expansion of BtoB and social service segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Oisix ra daichi emphasizes safe, high-quality, and convenient food solutions tailored to diverse lifestyles, with a strong focus on sustainability, health, and social impact. Its unique value lies in direct producer-consumer connections, premium and time-saving meal kits, eco-friendly practices, and the ability to address social issues such as food loss and rural accessibility. The company positions itself as a leader in 'specialty x subscription' within the food delivery sector.
